text_en: The next day Holofernes ordered his whole army, and all the allies who had joined him, to break camp and move against Bethulia, and to seize the passes up into the hill country and make war on the Israelites.
text_cn: 次日，敖罗斐乃下令全军和前来与他联盟的队伍，拔营向拜突里雅进发，先占领通往山地的隘口，向以色列子民挑战。

text_en: So all their warriors marched off that day; their fighting forces numbered one hundred seventy thousand infantry and twelve thousand cavalry, not counting the baggage and the foot soldiers handling it, a very great multitude.
text_cn: 那天，军队全体出发；作战的队伍，有步兵十七万，骑兵一万二千；此外还有辎重队，和随军步行的人，多得不可胜数；

text_en: They encamped in the valley near Bethulia, beside the spring, and they spread out in breadth over Dothan as far as Balbaim and in length from Bethulia to Cyamon, which faces Esdraelon.
text_cn: 在靠近拜突里雅的山谷中，在水泉旁安营。营幕绵延，长度由多堂到贝耳玛因，宽度由拜突里雅到厄斯得隆对面的夸孟。

text_en: When the Israelites saw their vast numbers, they were greatly terrified and said to one another, “They will now strip clean the whole land; neither the high mountains nor the valleys nor the hills will bear their weight. ”
text_cn: 以色列子民一见如此众多的军队，惊慌非常，都彼此说：“如今他们必将全地面一扫而光，连高山、幽谷、丘陵都担负不了他们的压力。”

text_en: Yet they all seized their weapons, and when they had kindled fires on their towers, they remained on guard all that night.
text_cn: 但以色列人还是各自拿着武器，在碉楼上点起烽火，那一整夜留守戒备。

text_en: On the second day Holofernes led out all his cavalry in full view of the Israelites in Bethulia.
text_cn: 第二天，敖罗斐乃把全部马队，开到住在拜突里雅的以色列子民面前，

text_en: He reconnoitered the approaches to their town, and visited the springs that supplied their water; he seized them and set guards of soldiers over them, and then returned to his army.
text_cn: 也探明了通往该城的山路，寻得了水泉，派兵占据把守，然后回到自己部队那里去了。

text_en: Then all the chieftains of the Edomites and all the leaders of the Moabites and the commanders of the coastland came to him and said,
text_cn: 厄撒乌子民的众长官，摩阿布民族的众首领，和沿海一带的司令，都来向敖罗斐乃说：

text_en: “Listen to what we have to say, my lord, and your army will suffer no losses.
text_cn: “愿我们的主帅听取一个建议，免得你的军队受害。

text_en: This people, the Israelites, do not rely on their spears but on the height of the mountains where they live, for it is not easy to reach the tops of their mountains.
text_cn: 以色列这个民族，原不依仗枪矛，惟独依靠所住的高山，因为攀登他们的山顶，并不是一件易事。

text_en: Therefore, my lord, do not fight against them in regular formation, and not a man of your army will fall.
text_cn: 主帅！如今不要同他们列阵交战，如此你的军人一个也不会伤亡。

text_en: Remain in your camp, and keep all the men in your forces with you; let your servants take possession of the spring of water that flows from the foot of the mountain,
text_cn: 你可留在营中，督守你军中所有的人马，只让你的仆役去占领山麓下涌出来的水泉，

text_en: for this is where all the people of Bethulia get their water. So thirst will destroy them, and they will surrender their town. Meanwhile, we and our people will go up to the tops of the nearby mountains and camp there to keep watch to see that no one gets out of the town.
text_cn: 因为凡住在拜突里雅的人，都从那里汲水。他们没有水喝，势必将城交出，同时我们率领我们的军人，上到附近的山顶上安营，监视他们，不许一人走出城来。

text_en: They and their wives and children will waste away with famine, and before the sword reaches them they will be strewn about in the streets where they live.
text_cn: 他们和妻子儿女必饥渴得衰弱无力，刀剑还未临到身上，他们已躺卧在靠近家门的街道上了。

text_en: Thus you will pay them back with evil, because they rebelled and did not receive you peaceably. ”
text_cn: 这样你可以恶毒地报复他们，因为他们顽抗，没有欢迎你。”

text_en: These words pleased Holofernes and all his attendants, and he gave orders to do as they had said.
text_cn: 他们的建议，大得敖罗斐乃和他众官员的欢心。于是下令，依照这建议办理。

text_en: So the army of the Ammonites moved forward, together with five thousand Assyrians, and they encamped in the valley and seized the water supply and the springs of the Israelites.
text_cn: 摩阿布子民就移营出发，与他们同去的，还有五千亚述人，驻扎在山谷中，占据了以色列子民的水渠和水泉。

text_en: And the Edomites and Ammonites went up and encamped in the hill country opposite Dothan; and they sent some of their men toward the south and the east, toward Egrebeh, which is near Chusi beside the Wadi Mochmur. The rest of the Assyrian army encamped in the plain, and covered the whole face of the land. Their tents and supply trains spread out in great number, and they formed a vast multitude.
text_cn: 厄撒乌的子孙及阿孟子民，也与一万二千亚述人上去，驻扎在多堂对面的山地。又从他们中派遣人，往厄格勒贝耳对面的东南方去，──厄格勒贝耳是在摩客慕尔河旁的雇士附近，──其余的亚述军队，驻扎在平原上，遮遍了地面；帐幕和辎重，堆集如山，多不胜数。

text_en: The Israelites then cried out to the Lord their God, for their courage failed, because all their enemies had surrounded them, and there was no way of escape from them.
text_cn: 以色列子民见自己四面受敌，不能逃出，都提心吊胆，遂向上主他们的天主哀号。

text_en: The whole Assyrian army, their infantry, chariots, and cavalry, surrounded them for thirty-four days, until all the water containers of every inhabitant of Bethulia were empty;
text_cn: 这时，亚述大军，即所有步兵、战车、马队，包围他们，已经三十四天了。拜突里雅居民所有的蓄水器，都已空了，

text_en: their cisterns were going dry, and on no day did they have enough water to drink, for their drinking water was rationed.
text_cn: 蓄水池都干了。人没有一天可得畅饮，因为水是分配给人喝的。

text_en: Their children were listless, and the women and young men fainted from thirst and were collapsing in the streets of the town and in the gateways; they no longer had any strength.
text_cn: 他们的幼儿渴的没有气力，妇女和青年，渴得发晕，倒在城内大街上和门口，再也没有一点力气。

text_en: Then all the people, the young men, the women, and the children, gathered around Uzziah and the rulers of the town and cried out with a loud voice, and said before all the elders,
text_cn: 于是全体民众、青年、妇女和幼童，都聚集在敖齐雅及城中首长那里，大声疾呼，当着众长老说：

text_en: “Let God judge between you and us! You have done us a great injury in not making peace with the Assyrians.
text_cn: “愿天主在你们与我们之间，施行审判；因为你们不同亚述人说和，使我们遭此大祸。

text_en: For now we have no one to help us; God has sold us into their hands, to be strewn before them in thirst and exhaustion.
text_cn: 如今我们不但没有救援，连天主也将我们交在他们手中，叫我们饥渴而死，都倒毙在他们面前。

text_en: Now summon them and surrender the whole town as booty to the army of Holofernes and to all his forces.
text_cn: 现今你们就叫他们进来，把全城交给敖罗斐乃的人民和大军，任凭他们抢掠。

text_en: For it would be better for us to be captured by them. We shall indeed become slaves, but our lives will be spared, and we shall not witness our little ones dying before our eyes, and our wives and children drawing their last breath.
text_cn: 我们更好当他们的战利品，因为我们虽然身为奴隶，但可保全性命，不至于眼看着我们的幼童夭亡，我们的妻子儿女，断送性命。

text_en: We call to witness against you heaven and earth and our God, the Lord of our ancestors, who punishes us for our sins and the sins of our ancestors; do today the things that we have described! ”
text_cn: 我们当着上天下地，因着我们的天主，即因惩罚我们的罪过，及我们祖先过犯的我们祖先的上主，恳求你们设法，别叫天主今日按照这些话来处置我们！”

text_en: Then great and general lamentation arose throughout the assembly, and they cried out to the Lord God with a loud voice.
text_cn: 集会的民众遂不约而同，都放声痛哭，向上主天主大声哀号。

text_en: But Uzziah said to them, “Courage, my brothers and sisters! Let us hold out for five days more; by that time the Lord our God will turn his mercy to us again, for he will not forsake us utterly.
text_cn: 敖齐雅遂对他们说：“弟兄们！振作精神，再忍耐五天，也许上主我们的天主，在这个时期内，向我们再施行他的仁慈，因为他决不会永远抛弃我们！

text_en: But if these days pass by, and no help comes for us, I will do as you say. ”
text_cn: 如果过了这日期，仍得不到救援，我就依照你们的话办理。"

text_en: Then he dismissed the people to their various posts, and they went up on the walls and towers of their town. The women and children he sent home. In the town they were in great misery.
text_cn: 遂遣散众人各归本营、城墙和城楼上；妇女幼童，一一遣送回家；当时全城陷于沮丧与绝望。
